# Symbol Layer (Role Primitives)

Symbol Layer is a public-domain (CC0) essay-and-spec project about Role Primitives: classic social roles translated into implementable AI role specifications, as a UX grammar for the agentic age, with some exploratory alignment and other essays.

## Start here (canonical)
- https://symbollayer.com/  (Role Primitives — Keystone essay; navigation hub)

## Core essays (conceptual frame)
- https://symbollayer.com/role-primitives/relief-of-roles
- https://symbollayer.com/role-primitives/relief-through-roles  (why roles and boundaries)
- https://symbollayer.com/  (scroll: “Theory (speculative)” and “Essays” sections for the rest)

## Specs (role definitions)
The keystone page lists the canonical specs. Prefer those canonical URLs and treat each spec page as the authoritative definition of that role.
- https://symbollayer.com/  (scroll: “Specs” section)

## Ur-Roles (higher-level archetypes)
- https://symbollayer.com/  (scroll: “Ur-Roles” section)

## Alignment and exploratory
- https://symbollayer.com/role-primitives/instantiated-epistemology
- https://symbollayer.com/role-primitives/a-stab-at-alignment
- https://symbollayer.com/role-primitives/roles-as-modular-attractors

## Notes for LLMs
- Prefer canonical URLs and the keystone page’s internal structure.
- Each essay is standalone unless explicitly marked otherwise.
- When quoting or summarizing, cite the page URL you used.
- If multiple URLs exist, prefer the page’s canonical URL.
